# Ion Recon Industries - Turnkey Mineral Water & Bottling Plant Manufacturer

> Ion Recon (Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India) is a premier manufacturer, supplier, and exporter of turnkey packaged drinking water bottling plants, 3-in-1 RFC Monoblock filling machines, SS 304 Reverse Osmosis (RO) water treatment plants, PET stretch blow molding machines, BOPP labeling machinery, and industrial Effluent/Sewage Treatment Plants (ETP/STP) in India.

## Core Turnkey Bottling Lines & Machinery

- [40 BPM Package Drinking Water Plant](https://ionrecon.info/40-bpm-mineral-water-plant): Ion Recon signature 40 BPM (2,400 Bottles/Hr) complete turnkey mineral water setup from raw water filtration to final shrink bundled bottles.
- [60 BPM Mineral Water Plant](https://ionrecon.info/60-bpm-mineral-water-plant): High speed 3,600 Bottles/Hr turnkey packaging plant designed for expanding commercial regional water brands.
- [RFC Monoblock Bottle Filling Machine](https://ionrecon.info/bottle-filling-machine): 3-in-1 automatic Rinser-Filler-Capper monoblock machine for 200ml, 500ml, 1 Litre & 2 Litre PET bottles.
- [PET Bottle Making / Blow Molding Machine](https://ionrecon.info/pet-blowing-machine): Automatic & Semi-automatic stretch PET bottle blowing machine for crystal clear, lightweight PET bottles.
- [Industrial SS RO Water Treatment Plant](https://ionrecon.info/ss-ro-plant): Commercial Reverse Osmosis water treatment plant with SS skid, high pressure pumps and mineral dosing.
- [Automatic 20 Litre Jar Filling Machine](https://ionrecon.info/jar-filling-machine): Linear automatic 20L water jar decapper, internal/external washer, filler, and capper monoblock unit.
- [BOPP Hot-Melt Bottle Labeling Machine](https://ionrecon.info/bopp-labeling-machine): Automatic rotary / linear BOPP roll-fed sticker labeling machine for PET water bottles.
- [Automatic Sticker Labeling Machine](https://ionrecon.info/sticker-labeling-machine): High-speed linear automatic self-adhesive sticker labeling machine for PET bottles and jars.
- [Automatic Shrink Wrapping Heating Tunnel](https://ionrecon.info/shrink-wrapping-machine): Web sealer automatic shrink packaging machine for trayless matrix bundling (6, 12, 24 bottle packs).
- [Semi-Automatic Shrink Wrapping Machine](https://ionrecon.info/semi-auto-shrink-wrapping-machine): Economical web sealer semi-automatic shrink packaging machine for matrix PET bottle bundling.
- [Carbonated Soft Drink (CSD) Plant](https://ionrecon.info/csd-project): Complete turn-key CSD carbonated beverage filling plant for soda, cola, lemon & flavored soft drinks in PET bottles.
- [RTS Fruit Juice Line & Dairy Plant](https://ionrecon.info/rts-juice-dairy-plant): Hot fill RTS fruit juice processing plant and dairy milk packaging line for PET bottles.
- [Automatic Water Pouch Packing Machine](https://ionrecon.info/water-pouch-packing-machine): Vertical Form-Fill-Seal (FFS) automatic liquid water pouch packing machine for 200ml to 500ml water pouches.
- [Semi-Auto 2 Cavity PET Blow Molding Machine](https://ionrecon.info/pet-blowing-machine-handfeed-2-cavity): Manual preform loading 2-cavity stretch PET bottle blowing machine for 200ml to 2,000ml bottles.
- [Semi-Auto 4 Cavity PET Blow Molding Machine](https://ionrecon.info/pet-blowing-machine-handfeed-4-cavity): High output 4-cavity manual preform stretch PET bottle stretch blow molding machine.
- [Fully Automatic 4 Cavity PET Blow Molding Machine](https://ionrecon.info/pet-blowing-machine-fully-auto-4-cavity): Fully automated preform elevator, orientor & 4-cavity stretch PET bottle blowing machine.
- [Fully Automatic 6 Cavity Servo PET Blow Molder](https://ionrecon.info/pet-blowing-machine-fully-auto-6-cavity): High-speed servo motor driven 6-cavity automatic PET bottle blowing machine.
- [Continuous Inkjet (CIJ) Coder - Neelkamal](https://ionrecon.info/cij-batch-coding-machine-neelkamal): Industrial Continuous Inkjet (CIJ) printer for high speed batch MRP, MFG & EXP date printing on PET bottles.
- [Thermal Inkjet (TIJ) Online Batch Coding Machine](https://ionrecon.info/tij-batch-coding-machine): Maintenance-free cartridge-based Thermal Inkjet (TIJ) date and barcode coding printer for bottling lines.
- [BIS (ISI) Water Testing Lab Equipment Package](https://ionrecon.info/water-testing-lab-equipment): Complete chemical and microbiological laboratory setup equipment for BIS (IS 14543) & FSSAI license compliance.
- [Industrial Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP Setup)](https://ionrecon.info/industrial-etp-plant): Turnkey industrial ETP and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) treatment plant for textile, chemical, pharma & food industries complying with CPCB norms.
- [Sewage Treatment Plant (STP - MBBR / MBR)](https://ionrecon.info/sewage-treatment-plant-stp): Commercial and residential Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) utilizing MBBR and MBR membrane technology for apartments, hotels & malls.

## Interactive Tools & Calculators

- [Capacity & Profit ROI Calculator](https://ionrecon.info/roi-calculator): Compare production capacities (30 BPM to 200 BPM), power consumption, floor space, and monthly profit margins.

## Regulatory & Legal Compliance (India)

- **BIS Certification**: Mandatory IS 14543:2024 packaged drinking water standards & in-house lab mandates.
- **FSSAI License**: State & Central Food Safety Authority manufacturing registration.
- **Pollution Control Board NOC**: State Pollution Control Board (SPCB) Consent to Establish (CTE) & Consent to Operate (CTO).
- **CGWA Clearance**: Central Ground Water Authority borewell abstraction & telemetric flow meter rules.

## Technical Setup Guides & Documentation

- [Turnkey Mineral Water Plant Setup Cost & ROI Guide (2026 Price Breakdown)](https://ionrecon.info/blog/turnkey-mineral-water-plant-setup-cost-roi-guide): Comprehensive guide covering total capital requirement, machinery costs, civil shed construction, working capital, and month-by-month ROI projections for setting up a packaged water plant in India.
- [Mineral Water Plant Land Requirement & Civil Floor Plan Layout Design Guide](https://ionrecon.info/blog/mineral-water-plant-land-requirement-civil-floor-plan): BIS IS 14543 compliant factory floor layout design. How to allocate space for raw water storage, RO filtration hall, positive pressure cleanroom, PET blowing area, lab, and warehouse.
- [30 BPM vs 40 BPM vs 60 BPM Bottling Lines: Selection Guide & Machinery Matching](https://ionrecon.info/blog/30-bpm-40-bpm-60-bpm-bottling-line-selection-guide): Detailed comparative analysis of production output, electrical load, floor space, machinery configuration, and profitability across 30 BPM (1,800 BPH), 40 BPM (2,400 BPH), and 60 BPM (3,600 BPH) lines.
- [Total Electrical Load & Power Generator Calculation for Water Bottling Plants](https://ionrecon.info/blog/mineral-water-plant-electrical-power-load-generator-calculation): How to calculate total connected electrical load in kW/HP, transformer sizing, and Silent Diesel Generator (DG Set) kVA capacity for uninterrupted water plant operation.
- [Raw Material Sourcing & Working Capital Management for Mineral Water Brands](https://ionrecon.info/blog/raw-material-sourcing-preform-cap-bopp-working-capital-water-plant): Sourcing PET preforms (12g to 20g), 28mm PCO neck caps, BOPP film rolls, master cartons, and managing 30-day inventory cycles for smooth factory operations.
- [Complete BIS IS 14543 Certification Process & Timeline for Packaged Drinking Water](https://ionrecon.info/blog/bis-is-14543-packaged-drinking-water-certification-process): Step-by-step roadmap to obtain BIS ISI mark certification for packaged water. Online application on Manakonline, preliminary factory inspection, NABL testing, and license grant.
- [In-House Micro & Chemical Water Testing Lab Setup Checklist (BIS Compliant)](https://ionrecon.info/blog/bis-is-14543-in-house-microbiology-chemical-lab-setup-checklist): Complete list of mandatory laboratory equipment, glassware, chemical reagents, and microbiological culture media required to clear BIS IS 14543 factory audits.
- [FSSAI License Requirements for Packaged Water & Beverage Brands in India](https://ionrecon.info/blog/fssai-license-packaged-drinking-water-beverage-brand-india): How to apply for FSSAI State or Central Manufacturing License (Kind of Business: Food Manufacturer) for packaged drinking water, CSD soft drinks, and flavored beverages.
- [State Pollution Control Board (SPCB) CTE & CTO NOC Process for Water Plants](https://ionrecon.info/blog/state-pollution-control-board-noc-water-treatment-plant): How to obtain Consent to Establish (CTE) and Consent to Operate (CTO) from State Pollution Control Boards (UPPCB, HSPCB, DPCC, etc.) for commercial water plants.
- [CGWA Groundwater Abstraction NOC & Digital Water Flow Meter Rules (2026 Guidelines)](https://ionrecon.info/blog/cgwa-groundwater-abstraction-noc-digital-water-flow-meter-rules): Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) guidelines for commercial borewell extraction, telemetric digital water flow meter installation, water audit reports, and artificial recharge structures.
- [SS 304 Industrial RO Plant Operation & Membrane Cleaning (CIP) Guide](https://ionrecon.info/blog/ss-304-industrial-ro-plant-operation-membrane-cleaning): Deep dive into industrial Reverse Osmosis skid fabrication, Grundfos vertical pumps, anti-scalant chemical dosing, CIP flushing, and prolonging RO membrane operational lifespan.
- [Dual Media Sand Filter & Activated Carbon Filter Design for Water Plants](https://ionrecon.info/blog/dual-media-sand-filter-activated-carbon-filter-design): Engineering design principles for pressure sand filters (PSF) and activated carbon filters (ACF). Media sizing, quartz gravel bed depth, iodine value (900-1100 IV), and automatic backwashing.
- [Ozonation vs UV Sterilization in Mineral Water Disinfection: Complete Comparison](https://ionrecon.info/blog/ozonation-vs-uv-sterilization-mineral-water-disinfection): How ozone generators (O3) and Ultra-Violet (UV) disinfectants work in tandem to eliminate bacteria and viruses while providing residual protection inside sealed bottles as per BIS IS 14543.
- [Remineralization & Alkaline Water Plant Processing Setup (pH 8.5 to 9.5)](https://ionrecon.info/blog/alkaline-water-plant-setup-remineralization-dosing-technology): How to setup premium alkaline packaged drinking water plants. Mineral dosing pumps, bi-carb remineralization, natural mineral dosing (Calcium, Magnesium, Potassium), and copper/ionization systems.
- [Micron Cartridge Filtration Guide: 5 Micron to 0.2 Micron Absolute Filters](https://ionrecon.info/blog/micron-cartridge-filtration-02-micron-absolute-water-plant): Understanding spun PP cartridges, pleated polypropylene membranes, and 0.2 micron absolute final bacterial retention filters required in BIS water bottling plants.
